text: 国务院新闻办公室举行新闻发布会，商务部介绍所谓“产能过剩”问题中方立场有关情况，并答记者问。 发布会上介绍，中国产品满足各国生产生活需要。中国生产的电脑、手机、家具、服装、玩具等消费品，为各国消费者提供了更多的选择，降低了消费成本，缓冲了通胀风险。
text_en: The State Council Information Office held a press conference where the Ministry of Commerce introduced China's position on the so-called "overcapacity" issue and answered questions. The press conference stated that Chinese products meet the production and living needs of various countries. Chinese-made consumer goods such as computers, phones, furniture, clothing, and toys offer consumers in various countries more choices, reduce consumption costs, and buffer inflation risks.
